limits: This is a read-only patch and call-site review, not an independently executed full platform gate.
Platform fmt/clippy/test outcomes must be read from their own source-bound receipts.

observations.finding: Every newly added cfg condition preserves the Linux items. The changed unix-to-linux type guard remains enabled on Linux. No Linux descriptor/mount/ownership guard is removed.
The tuple annotation and movement of Published to the parent module resolve non-Linux type inference; the Linux publish body and its returned fields are unchanged.

same_device uses checked TryInto<u64>. On Linux dev_t already uses an unsigned identity representable as u64; equality is preserved. Unrepresentable or negative Darwin identities fail closed instead of narrowing or wrapping.

The existing native JSON acquisition, atomic model publication and predecessor replay refusal paths remain explicit. Empty non-Linux CommitPhase cannot cause a publication callback because the non-Linux path refuses.

No test body is removed. The new portable device-comparison test covers equal, unequal, negative and too-wide values. Native JSON integration tests were already Linux-only in the base; json_eof and manifest/provider helpers remain present under cfg(test).
